PennGlobal: PMR47
Period: VS 1267 phālguṇa vadi 10
Location: Pipliānagar
Dynasty: Paramāra
King: Arjunavarman
Language: Sanskrit
Script: Nagari
Text: Prose and Metrical in 23 verses
Metres: Vv. 1-19, 21-22 Anuṣṭubh(śloka); v.20 Vasantatilakā; v.23 Puṣpitāgrā
Gist: Donation of an entire village
Published reference: Trivedi (1978), no. 47.


Text{1}

oṃ{2} namaḥ puruṣārthacūḍāmaṇaye dharmmāya ||
pratibiṃbatayā bhūmeḥ kṛtvā sākṣātpratigrahaṃ{3} |
jagadāhlādayan diśyād dbijeṃdro{4} maṅgalāni vaḥ ||1||
jīyātparaśurāmosau kṣatraiḥ kṣuṇyā{5} rāṇāhataiḥ |
saṃdhyārkabiṃbameyorvī dāturyyasyaiti tāmratāṃ{6} ||2||
yena maṃdodarībāṣpavāribhiḥ śamito mṛdhe |
prāṇeśvarīviyogāgniḥ sa rāmaḥ śreyase'stu vaḥ{7} ||3||
bhīmenāpi dhṛtau mūrddhani yatpādau sa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
vaṃśādyeneṃdunā jīyātsvatulya iva nirmitaḥ ||4||
paramārakulottaṃsaḥ kaṃsajinmahimā nṛpaḥ |
śrībhojadeva ityāsīdāsīmakrāṃtabhūtalaḥ ||5||
yadyaśaścaṃdrikodeti{8} digutsaṃgataraṃgite |
dviṣannṛpayaśaḥpuṃjapuṃḍarīkairnimīlitaṃ{9} ||6||
tatobhūdadayādityo nityotsahaikakautukī |
asādhāraṇavīraśrīraśrīheturvirodhināṃ{10} ||7||
mahākalahakalpāṃte yasyoddāmabhirāśugaiḥ |
kati nonmūlitāstuṃgā bhūbhṛtaḥ kaṭakolvaṇāḥ{11} ||8||
tasmādbhinnadviṣanmarmā naravarmā narādhipaḥ |
dharmābhyuddharaṇe dhīmānabhūtsīmā mahībhujāṃ{12} ||9||
pratima(pra ?)bhātaṃ viprebhyo dattairgrāmapadaiḥ svayaṃ{13} |
anekapadatāṃ ninye dharmo yenaikapādapi ||10||
tasyājani yaśovarmā putraḥ kṣatriyaśekharaḥ |
tasmādajayavarmābhūjjayaśrīviśrutaḥ sutaḥ ||11||
tatsūnurvīramūrdhanyo dhanyotpattirajāyata |
gurjaroche(cche)danirbaṃdhī viṃdhyavarmā mahābhujaḥ ||12||
dhārayoddhṛtayā sārddhaṃ dadhāti sma tridhāratāṃ{14} |
sāṃyugīnasya yasyāsistrātuṃ lokatrayīmiva ||13||
tasyāmuṣyāyaṇaḥ putraḥ sutrāmaśrīrathāśiṣat |
bhūpaḥ subhaṭavarmeti dharme tiṣṭhanmahītalaṃ{15} ||14||
yasya jvalati digjetuḥ pratāpastapanadyuteḥ |
dāvāgnisumanā{16}'dyāpi garjangurjarapattane ||15||
devabhūyaṃ gate tasminnaṃdano'rjunabhūpatiḥ |
doṣnā(ṣṇā ) dhatte'dhunā dhābhī(?){17}balayaṃ balayaṃ yathā ||16||
vā(bā)lalīlāhave yasya jayasiṃhe palāyite |
dikyā(kpā)lahāsavyājena yaśo dikṣu vijṛmbhitaṃ{18} ||17||
kāvyagāṃdharvasarvasvanidhinā yena sāṃprataṃ{19} |
bhārāvataraṇaṃ devyāścakre pustakavīṇayoḥ ||18||
tena trividhavīreṇa{20} tridhā pallavitaṃ yaśaḥ |
dhavalatvaṃ dadhustrīṇi jagaṃti kathamanyathā ||19||

sa eva naranāyakaḥ sarvābhyudayi śakapurapratijāgaraṇake piḍiviḍigrāme samastarājapuruṣān brāhmaṇottarān prati-
nivāsipaṭṭakilajanapadādīṃśca bodhayatyastu vaḥ saṃviditaṃ yathā maṃḍapadurgāvasthitairasmābhiḥ saptaṣaṣṭyadhikadvādaśaśatasaṃvatsare
phālguṇe(ne) 1237{21} śukladaśamyāmabhiṣekaparvaṇi snātvā bhagavataṃ bhavānīpatimabhyarcya saṃsārasyāsāratāṃ dṛṣṭvā
tathāhi |

vātābhravibhramamidaṃ vasudhādhipatyamāpātamātramadhuro viṣayopabhogaḥ | prāṇāstṛṇāgrajalabindusamā narāṇāṃ dharmaḥ sakhā paramaho
paralokayāne ||20||

iti sarvaṃ vimṛśyādṛṣṭaphalamaṃgīkṛtya muktāvasusthānavinirgatāya vājasaneyaśākhādhyāyine kāśyapagotrāya kāśyapa{22}vatsāranaidhruvatripravarāya
śravamāvikadelavasāvikadelaṇamaprapautrāya{23} paṃḍitasomadevapautrāya paṃḍitajaitrasiṃhaputrāya purohitagoviṃdaśarmaṇe brāhmaṇāya samastopi grāmaścatuḥ-
(ṣ)kaṃkaṭaviśuddhaḥ savṛkṣampa(mā)lākulaḥ sahiraṇyabhāgabhogaḥ sopaskaraḥ{24} sarvadāyasametaḥ savinikṣepo{25} mātāpitrorātmanaśca
puṇyayaśo'bhivṛddhaye caṃdrārkārṇavakṣitisamakālaṃ yāvatparayā bhaktyā śāsanenodakapūrvvaṃ pradattaḥ tanmatvā tannivāsipaṭṭakilajanapadairya-
thādīyamāna(naṃ) bhāgabhogahiraṇyādikaṃ devabrāhmaṇabhuktivarjamājñāśravaṇavidheyairbhūtvā sarvamamuṣmai dātavyaṃ{26} | sāmānyaṃ
caitatpuṇyaphalaṃ budhvā(ddhvā)'smadvaṃśajairanyairapi bhāvibhoktṛbhirasmatpradattadharmādāyo'yamanumaṃtavyaḥ pālanīyaśca | uktaṃ ca |
va(ba)hubhirvasudhā bhuktā rājabhiḥ | sama(ga)rādibhiḥ | yasya yasya yadā bhūmistasya tasya tadā phalaṃ(lam)
||21|| svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā yo hareta vasuṃdharāṃ(rām) | sa viṣṭhāyāṃ kri(kṛ)mirbhūtvā pitṛbhiḥ saha
majjati ||22|| iti kamaladalāṃbubiṃdulolāṃ śriyamanuciṃtya manuṣyajīvitaṃ ca |
sakalamidamudāhṛtaṃ ca budhvā(ddhvā) na hi puruṣaiḥ parakīrttayo vilopyāḥ ||23||
saṃvat 1237{27} phālguṇa(na)śuddha 10 gurau racitamidaṃ mahāpaṃḍitaśrībilhaṇasaṃmatena rājaguruṇā madanena ||

--------------------------
{1} As transcribed by L. Wilkinson in J.A.S.B., Vol.V, pp.378-79. He did not give the text line by line.
{2} Probably denoted by a symbol, as usual.
{3} Read -haṃ. In biṃba that precedes and in all the other instances in this record, the consonant v for b
	seems to have been used in the original.
{4} This word here means dvija-rāja, i.e., the moon and the idea implied is as the moon takes (the sun's
	rays) for giving away (reflecting them), so the Brāhmaṇas also.
{5} Read kṣuṇṇā.
{6} Read -tām. The word mēyā is used to mean "worth comparing (with the rising or setting Sun)".
{7} Wilkinson, and following him, Hall, misunderstood this verse, which means that Rāma, who in the battle,
	allayed the fire (pang) of separation from the beloved (Sītā) with the water in the form of Maṇḍodarī's
	tears, may be for your welfare.
{8} Read -dyote, as in the following two grants, which are exact copies of this.
{9} Read -taṃ.
{10} Read -nām. For the sense of the second quarter of this verse, see n.2 on p.162.
{11} Here, the words bhūbhṛt and kaṭaka are used in double sense, the first of these to denote a king and a 
	 mountain, and the second, an army and a ridge.
{12} Read -jāṃ.
{13} Read -yaṃ.
{14} Read -tāṃ. This implies the two blades of his sword, with the capital town Dhārā. For the transla-
	 tion of this verse, see Ind. Ant., Vol.XIX, p.346, n.
{15} Read -laṃ.
{16} This is evidently wrong. Read chajhanā, as in the other grants of the King.
{17} Read -dhātrī as in No.49 (v.16), which is its copy.
{18} Read -taṃ.
{19} Read -taṃ.
{20} The expression trividha vīra signifies dharma vīra, dāna vīra and yuddha vīra.
{21} In view of the date being clearly mentioned here in words, this should be corrected to 1267.
{22} Read kāśyapāvatsāra-.
{23} As in the following grant, read avasathikadelhapra-.
{24} Read soparikaraḥ.
{25} Read sanidhinikṣepo-.
{26} Read -vyaṃ.
{27} See n. on the correction of the date on the preceding page.
